pins.issue: U7 pin 5 (VO1) = SPK_P, R35 Rf from SPK_P to -IN (VO1 is the feedback output). BTL: speaker polarity only sets acoustic phase; no standard.
Neither lead may touch GND (BTL). PCB pads: 2x3 mm on 4 mm pitch, nets SPK_P/SPK_N as design.
